editorial.blurb: Qing Xiang Yuan is a modern dumpling destination that delivers consistently excellent handmade dumplings with meticulous attention to craft and presentation.
editorial.insiderTip: Add yourself to the waitlist on the iPad at the restaurant to avoid confusion—expect a 30-minute wait, which gives you time to explore nearby Chinatown. Pair your dumplings with their house-made chilli crisp and award-winning vinegar for the full experience.
signatureDishes: Pan fried tofu cabbage mushroom dumpling
